description: The former official starter (webpack + Babel + Jest). Deprecated in February 2025; do not use it for new projects.
A fast dev server and bundler. `npm create vite@latest -- --template react-ts` scaffolds a React SPA.
Next.js, React Router v7 framework mode or Expo: routing, data loading and rendering strategies in one package.
`createRoot(container).render(<App />)` mounts a React app. Replaced `ReactDOM.render`, removed in React 19.
Hot module replacement: edited modules are swapped in the running app without a full reload.
